references.text: The same pattern where the children of Israel cry out to the Lord and He raises up a deliverer (Othniel) for them
The children of Israel cry out to the Lord for help, and He raises up Deborah and Barak as deliverers
The same pattern is repeated: Israel cries out to the Lord in their distress, and He sends a deliverer (Gideon)
The children of Israel cry out to the Lord and confess their sin, which leads to deliverance
Israel cries out to God in their distress during slavery in Egypt, and God hears their cry
The tribe of Benjamin is mentioned; Ehud was a Benjamite (ben-hayemini)
Kish from the tribe of Benjamin shows the prominent role of the Benjamites in Israel's history
God raises up deliverers for Israel, a recurring theme in Israel's history
The Lord sends a deliverer and defender to those who cry out to Him
When Israel cried out to God, He sent deliverers who rescued them from their enemies
